g.text: Quarters relative to the first quarter after coverage ended or lapsed (dashed line)
Normalised change, 2025 Q4 to 2026 Q1: change in obesity_wz prescriptions relative to the state's all-drug change (preliminary)
Source: CMS State Drug Utilization Data and Medicaid enrollment (warehouse marts). Gross of rebates; counts under 11 suppressed by CMS. PRELIMINARY:
2026 Q1 is preliminary SDUD data; only one post-withdrawal quarter exists for most states (North Carolina lapsed 2025-10-01 to 2025-12-11 and
resumed). New Hampshire is a sensitivity state.
Descriptive only: no model, no p-values; 2026 Q1 is preliminary SDUD data. Normalised change = (1 + obesity_wz change) / (1 +
all-drug SDUD change) - 1 for 2025 Q4 to 2026 Q1; raw changes are in the table (obesity_wz: CA -75.7%, PA -95.5%, continuously
covered median -1.6%; all drugs: CA -26.0%, PA -51.0%, median -17.9%).
Preliminary: relative to their all-drug change, Wegovy/Zepbound prescriptions changed -67.2% in CA
and -90.8% in PA after coverage ended, versus a median of 31.9% in the 6 continuously covered states
